note: The pinned toolchain (plan 198). Installed by uv into the harness's own folder, never system-wide. Node comes as a Python package for pyright (measured 2026-10-15: pyright 0.56 s on Node, 1.44 s on Bun; Bun is not needed).

python_packages.fastapi: latest pinned at the starter project's uv.lock

typescript: 7.0.2 (the native compiler): checks the JSDoc types of no-server apps (kit/starter-static) in strict mode, 0.4 s; run with only uv: uvx --from nodejs-wheel-binaries==24.19.0 npx --yes -p typescript@7.0.2 tsc -p .
chromium: Chrome for Testing headless shell 155.0.8059.79 (harness/setup.py HEADLESS_SHELL), installed by `plh setup browser` into <data>/toolchain/chrome-headless-shell, checked against the MD5 Google's storage publishes. Measured 2026-10-15 on this Mac with Pi's browser tool: 525 ms and ~420 MB per look vs 837 ms and 922 MB for the full Chromium; 211 MB on disk vs 305 MB. Lightpanda: no layout engine, not usable.
